name: package-guard
description: Before Claude installs or runs a package (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, npx, pip, uv, poetry, pipx, cargo), asks the public registry about it. Holds the command when the package does not exist (a made-up name), is under 14 days old, or looks like a well-known package and is young or thin (typosquatting). Allow in the band or with /pkg-allow.

mode.title: Package Guard: mode
mode.description: block: hold the command until the package is allowed. warn: only warn and let it through.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the texts this mod shows and writes.
